notes.title: New Changelog
notes.content:
[p]Thought I'd make a proper changelog for whenever we make small edits like this. If the game ever updates and you're wondering why, you can check here![/p][p][/p][p]Version 3.36[/p][list][*][p] Fixed some sprites where Olive was missing their blush markings.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a sprite where Olive's paws were the wrong color.[/p][/*][/list][p] Version 3.40[/p][list][*][p] Edited the Japanese translations so the UI menus were consistent with the other games' recent translations![/p][/*][/list][p] Version 3.41[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where, after an update, the game would start in Japanese and muted. The game now launches in English at 50% volume if it's been updated/reinstalled.[/p][/*][/list][p] Version 3.42[/p][list][*][p]Added version number to options screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added text animations (only affects English language).[/p][/*][*][p]Added custom cursor.[/p][/*][*][p]Added voice bites for every character.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few spelling/grammar/punctuation errors.[/p][/*][*][p]For those who go through code, updated the im.MatrixColor properties to work with the newest version of Renpy. Shouldn’t affect gameplay, just code![/p][/*][*][p]On start up the character voice volume is 50% instead of 100% to match default SFX and music volumes.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Version 3.47[/p][list][*][p]Included some edits for the Polish translation.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Update for Mobile Translations!
notes.content:
hello hello! i'm just updating the pa series on steam so the code is consistent between the games and their mobile versions, which will now be supporting all the translations the series has accumulated to date! included in this update are:
* small tweaks to button text sizes/positioning
* added translated main menu image for brazilian portuguese (currently only pa1)
* expanded the bani-regular font to include cyrillic characters
* changed button names for consistency between russian translations

in other words, most things won't affect you if you're just playing the english version on pc. that's all for this minor update, hope yall have an amazing day and thank you as always for enjoying our games!!

notes.title: Purrfect Apawcalypse 2: Now in Chinese!
notes.content:
heya everyone! purrfect apawcalypse: purrgatory furever (along with the rest of the series) is now available in chinese! to change the language all you gotta do is boot up the game, open the options menu and select your language! thanks so much to 荼郁 and 雾子 for their translation of the game, i hope the chinese-speaking community enjoys having the translation officially on steam. :> anyway that's all for now, thank you as always for supporting our funny lil furry games, have an awesome day!

edit: there may be short updates from time to time as we iron out typos and small bugs! most recently fixed a bug with the disable bug not appearing translated. :>

notes.title: Purrfect Apawcalypse 2: Now in Japanese!
notes.content: hello hello, there's now a japanese translation for purrfect apawcalypse 2 thank you so much [url=https://twitter.com/mme62939094]même [/url]for your work! if you'd like to try it out, the language option is accessible in the options menu of the game. purrfect apawcalypse 1 and 3 might also receive japanese translations but that's still in the works, sorry for the odd ordering of things. in the meantime, thanks for playing and enjoy your day!!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
just updated the trilogy with changes that don't really affect the player (with the exception of a bug where, after acing the game and seeing the short secret scene, the credits appear completely black. that bug's now been fixed!). this update just makes the code consistent with the mobile and itch versions of the game. this helps us fix bugs across the board if one crops up. thanks for playing and enjoy the steam summer sale! :>

edit: the update archived the images in the game folder by accident, they've now been unarchived for your memery! same goes for scripts now!

notes.title: "Purrfect Apawcalypse: Purrgatory Furever" is now released!
notes.content:
Heya everyone, thank you so much for supporting the Purrfect Apawcalypse trilogy's transition to Steam! Purrfect Apawcalypse: Purrgatory Furever has now been released here, hope y'all enjoy!

For the itch-players out there, I'm currently waiting on keys to release to those who've already purchased PA2 on itch (as well as PA1 steam keys for those who purchased PA1 on itch). You should be able to access your steam key within a few days, I'll announce it on itch just to make sure you're in the loop. In the meantime the itch version will be updated to match the improvements in the Steam version!

I think that's all. I hope all goes well with this release! Thanks again! <3 ^u^
